changelogversion.changelogtext: [b]New[/b] Webtoon tap scroll distance: half / 3/4 / full screen
[b]New[/b] Webtoon tap scroll uses constant-speed animation, duration adjustable (0-1000ms, default 250ms)
[b]New[/b] Auto webtoon detection also checks image aspect ratio (height/width > 2.5)
[b]New[/b] Komga tracker sync now marks only the actually read chapter (per-book PATCH), other chapters unaffected
[b]New[/b] Image enhancement: Anime4K (GPU shader, Fast/High/Ultra) and Lanczos3 (CPU, 1.5x/2x/3x), lightweight without heavy models
[b]New[/b] Original resolution option for webtoon mode (1:1 pixel display, no scaling)
[b]Changed[/b] App renamed to MihonSY, package eu.kanade.mihonsy
[b]Changed[/b] Removed update checker, no longer checks for updates online
